# Code of conduct

[DEVICE TWEAKER](../README.md) / Community · [Русский](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.ru.md)

These rules apply to issues, pull requests and project discussions.

- Treat other contributors with respect, even when you disagree.
- Discuss the evidence. Share relevant logs or measurements when they clarify the issue.
- Get permission before sharing anyone else's personal data, keys or files.
- Keep discussions free of insults, harassment, discrimination and spam.

Moderators may hide or remove messages and block accounts that break these rules. Report a violation to the project author via [Telegram](https://t.me/arsenzaaaa).
